motion.name: cover-ready-background
motion.purpose: Fade the woodland background in after images and fonts are ready; reduced motion uses 200ms.

motion.name: cover-ready-content
motion.purpose: Fade the cover content in after images and fonts are ready; reduced motion uses 150ms.

motion.name: monogram-handoff
motion.purpose: Move and scale the paper-tinted supplied framed DR monogram toward the stationary original sage formal monogram; reduced motion removes spatial movement.

motion.name: cover-dissolve
motion.purpose: Fade the woodland opening away, then restore scrolling and focus the formal invitation; reduced motion uses 200ms. Direct section links and existing scroll positions bypass the opening.

motion.name: monogram-crossfade
motion.purpose: Crossfade the paper-tinted and original sage versions of the supplied framed DR PNG during the handoff; reduced motion fades only the paper-tinted version away over 150ms with no delay.

motion.name: opening-prompt-fade
motion.purpose: Fade cover names, date, and prompt on opening; reduced motion uses 200ms.

motion.name: formal-text-reveal
motion.purpose: Fade formal invitation text after opening without moving the monogram; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: navigation-reveal
motion.purpose: Fade navigation after opening; keyboard focus makes it visible immediately, and reduced motion bypasses the reveal.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal each content group once at intersection threshold .08 with opacity and a 10px upward rise. Grouping avoids nested duplicate motion; focused content appears immediately. Reduced motion or unavailable IntersectionObserver bypasses reveals.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Action color/background changes and FAQ chevron; disabled for reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
This client inherits Vincent and Gabrielle's confirmed invitation world: warm ivory paper, olive ink, Anastasia handwriting, woodland photography, and fine ornaments. The system belongs to this invitation folder; the repository's marketing design is separate.

The page reads vertically, retaining the proportions and ceremonial quiet of the reference stationery. Decorative photographs support the paper and lettering. The user-supplied sage framed DR PNG appears on the formal invitation and receives a paper tint on the cover. Navigation uses only the central black initials cropped from the user's black framed PNG.
keyCharacteristics: Anastasia names, sentimental copy, and section titles; only The Entourage title uses Noto Serif.
Thin double frames, symmetrical flourishes, and monogram artwork.
Centered reading surfaces with responsive paired lists.

rules.name: The Paper and Woodland Rule
rules.body: Keep the reference's alternation of paper, olive, and woodland surfaces; maintain readable lettering over photographs with the existing dark overlays.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Keep Anastasia for section titles, names, sentimental supporting copy, and timeline event labels; use Noto Serif for information. The only main-heading serif exception is “The Entourage”; do not extend it to other headings, Our Wedding Party, or RSVP.

rules.name: The Title Then Ornament Rule
rules.body: Place each section title above its top ornamental divider. The shared heading pairs a title with the flourish below it using the title-gap spacing token.

dos: **Do** preserve the confirmed olive-and-ivory reference palette, local fonts, fine frames, and exact supplied DR PNG artwork.
**Do** place titles above their ornaments, using Noto Serif only for The Entourage main title and Anastasia for the other headings, RSVP, names, sentimental copy, and timeline labels.
**Do** maintain readable dark overlays, keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** use client-local assets and scoped decorative CSS with Tailwind layout utilities.
donts: **Don't** replace this inherited invitation world with the repository's marketing theme.
**Don't** add couple-photo slides or horizontal page turns to this scrolling invitation.
**Don't** redraw, distort, or rebuild the supplied monogram from separate assets, or substitute earlier generated concepts for the approved PNGs.
**Don't** spread the reply card's shadow or rounded corners across the stationery sections.
